core_obligations: Reduction to sections over an object (proof lines 5884-5894): the author fixes an object of the localized site, forms the pullbacks of the members of the covering along it, and identifies the values of the restrictions of the sheaves over that object and over the pairwise products.

Construction of the glued map (proof lines 5895-5911): the compatibility of the given maps makes the product of the maps descend to the equalizers describing the values of the sheaves on the covering, which defines the map on sections over the chosen object by the dotted arrows of the displayed diagram.
Closing (proof lines 5912-5916): the equality signs come from the sheaf condition, and the author records that the verification of compatibility with the restriction maps is omitted.
proof_roadmap: Fix an object of the localized site and form the induced covering.
Use the sheaf condition and the compatibility of the given maps to define the glued map on sections.
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that maps of sheaves defined over the members of a covering, agreeing on the pairwise intersections, glue uniquely to a map over the whole object (statement lines 5854-5881). The proof is a complete construction: for an object of the localized site the author forms the induced covering and identifies the relevant values of the restrictions (proof lines 5884-5894); the compatibility of the given maps makes the product map descend to the equalizers coming from the sheaf condition, which defines the glued map by the dotted arrows of a displayed diagram (proof lines 5895-5911); and the author records that the verification of compatibility with restrictions is omitted (proof lines 5914-5916), a routine check preserved verbatim in the counted span. The non-formal content is the descent to the equalizer. The claim is H2: a construction with the closing verification noted.
